title: New law: A bill to continue in effect any authority provided under the Department of Justice Appropriation Authorization Act, Fiscal Year 1980, for a certain period. (Public Law 97-7)
summary: S. 840 of the 97th Congress became Public Law 97-7 on 1981-04-09.

title: New law: A joint resolution to authorize and request the President to issue a proclamation designating April 9, 1981, as "African Refugee Relief Day". (Public Law 97-8)
summary: S.J.Res. 61 of the 97th Congress became Public Law 97-8 on 1981-04-09.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate April 26, 1981, as "National Recognition Day for Veterans of the Vietnam Era". (Public Law 97-9)
summary: H.J.Res. 182 of the 97th Congress became Public Law 97-9 on 1981-04-14.
